subject: [PATCH v8 20/30] mm/madvise: free PMD swap entries with MADV_FREE

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's memory management to free PMD swap entries when using the MADV_FREE advisory. Currently, madvise_free_pte_range() only frees present THP pages and ignores swapped-out pages. The patch introduces a new approach where it checks if the entire PMD is covered by the advice and, if so, frees all its slots at once. Otherwise, it splits the range into smaller sub-ranges that can be handled by the PTE path. This change ensures that MADV_FREE over a swapped-out THP silently does nothing, which was the previous behavior.
